parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Surrey · Newton

East Newton is an MLS® area in the Newton part of Surrey. The City uses the name for the neighbourhoods around Chimney Hill, east of 144 Street, north of 64 Avenue and Hyland Creek, and south of Bear Creek. On the MLS® map, East Newton runs roughly from King George Boulevard east to 152 Street, and from about 64 Avenue north to Bear Creek, around 80 to 84 Avenue. The edges are approximate.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 13, 2026. I have worked in Fraser Valley real estate for 11+ years. Facts come from the official sources noted on this page. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Surrey and Surrey Schools.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

In East Newton, schools, parks, recreation centres and shops are all close, so daily errands stay short. Major commuter routes are also nearby, which makes it easy to get around Surrey and into the cities next door.
East Newton draws steady demand and offers several kinds of property, which keeps it popular among buyers in the Surrey real estate market who want affordability, space and long-term potential.

parts.t: Zoning and plan designations can be different for each lot.
The City says East Newton was planned through three neighbourhood concept plans, guided by the 1993 Local Area Plan for East Newton, and that these plans are now largely built out.
The City describes the area as including schools such as Chimney Hill and T.E. Scott, and the Valley View Cemetery.

Since the Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan was adopted in June 2026, the East Newton North plan has been rescinded. The land use designations in the East Newton South and East Newton Business Park plans have been replaced by the Official Community Plan, though those two plans still guide parks, amenities and services.
